workflow_runs.name: CLA Assistant
workflow_runs.display_title: core: preconnect Responses websocket for first turn

head_commit.message:
core: simplify websocket preconnect flow and tests

Simplify preconnect state by caching only a preconnected websocket and
minimal turn state needed for sticky routing continuity.

Deduplicate websocket setup by introducing shared header/connect helpers
used by both preconnect and normal connection paths, and remove
preconnect reuse gating on connection-scoped headers.

Move startup preconnect into a single model-client call and tighten tests
to use deterministic handshake waits while accounting for background
preconnect timing.
